outcomes.test_results: fabro-cli 1089/1089, fabro-test 28/28, gate-red set 75/75 with FABRO_SERVER exported and unset, docker-less host

name: env-robust CLI test isolation seam
description: Three-layer fix for CLI integration tests that red on environment-sensitive hosts (run sandboxes, root-less CI): (1) in-process clap parse tests scrub env-backed args via temp_env::with_var (ambient FABRO_SERVER populates shared --server and turns is_none() assertions into env artifacts); (2) tests that execute runs gate on fabro_test::docker_available() with a REAL early return in the test body — a guard helper that returns from itself is a no-op, verify by observing the 'skipping:' notice; (3) harness env isolation (fabro-test apply_test_isolation) opts git out of dubious-ownership checks via GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_0/VALUE_0=safe.directory=* env plus a HOME .gitconfig — libgit2 (git2 discover) and git CLI both honor these, so fixture() paths inside a foreign-owned checkout bundle fine.
